articles.summary: Saba Ali Pataudi recalled her mother Sharmila Tagore's conversion to Islam after marrying Tiger Pataudi, and how she taught her children about it. articles.title: 266 days deployed: USS Abraham Lincoln to return home amid rising scrutiny over sailor welfare
articles.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln, a prominent US Navy aircraft carrier, is returning home after an extended 266-day deployment. This move comes amidst increasing scrutiny and concerns regarding the welfare of its sailors after such a prolonged period at sea. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the demanding nature of naval deployments and the critical importance of personnel well-being within defence forces.

articles.title: TGBIE Class 11 admission 2026: Deadline extended to August 31, Principals directed to follow reservation rules
articles.summary: The Telangana Board of Intermediate Education (TGBIE) has extended the Class 11 admission deadline to August 31 for the 2026 academic year, offering students more time to apply. Principals are concurrently directed to rigorously follow all reservation rules during the admission process. This ensures fair access and compliance with state policies for intermediate education, impacting numerous aspirants in Telangana.
